messages:
marta.s: Heads up — compliance export for Q1 shows 842 permission_change rows but our audit index has 1,279. Can someone look?
raj.k: I see 1,279 locally. Which export path are you looking at?
marta.s: s3://compliance-exports/2026-q1/perm-changes.csv — filtered event_type=permission_change -> 842 rows
natalie.g: We pushed the RBAC refactor last week that added role_alias handling. Could the export be dropping non-user actor types?
security-bot: alert: KMS key rotation completed 2026-02-10T02:14Z — some archived events were written with legacy envelope format
sam.t: If actor is null the export job's schema validation likely rejects the row. Can you paste an example rejected record?
marta.s: here's one from the export job logs that got omitted: 
```
{ "event_id": "evt-0a1b2c", "timestamp": "2026-02-11T10:04:22Z", "source": "rbac-service-v2", "change": "role_assigned", "target": {"principal": "user:alice"}, "actor": null }
```
raj.k: I ran an ES aggregation on audit-* for source:rbac-service-v2 AND change:role_assigned — counts by actor.type: user=743, service_account=536 -> total 1,279
marta.s: so export has 842, ES has 1,279 — missing ~437 events, looks like the service_account slice is absent
natalie.g: confirmed — export pipeline etl/export_permissions has a filter step that effectively does `actor.type == "user"` after the refactor. It was meant to reduce infra noise, but now it drops service_account events too.
sam.t: how did that land without a test? Was it behind a flag?
natalie.g: it was a quick guard in PR #4123 — not behind a flag. We missed the compliance use-case for service accounts (vendor automation, CI bots that request ephemeral grants).
marta.s: This is a compliance gap. Those service_account changes represent vendor/partner access grants we must report. We need a mitigation and a backfill plan.
raj.k: Immediate mitigation: update the export job to include actor.type IN ("user","service_account") and re-run the nightly export. Also prepare a backfill that extracts the missing events and appends to the CSV.
sam.t: I'll open a hotfix PR to relax the filter and redeploy the ETL. Plan: 1) patch export pipeline, 2) run backfill extraction for 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 -> s3://compliance-exports/2026-q1/backfill/ , 3) push notice to @compliance-team. ETA: patch in ~2h, backfill start after patch depending on size (~4-6h).
natalie.g: Also note some events have actor encrypted metadata missing due to the KMS rotation — we saw legacy envelopes written that don't deserialize actor fields. That will produce actor=null even if it existed originally.
marta.s: Where are the legacy envelopes stored? Can we decrypt and recover actor info for backfill?
natalie.g: legacy envelopes are in s3://audit-legacy-envelopes/. We have a tool decrypt_legacy_audit.py but it requires temporary access to the rotated KMS key ARN to decrypt those envelopes. Without that, the actor will stay null.
infra-oncall: I'll spin up a ticket for temporary decrypt permissions and coordinate with KMS owners. Grant window request in ticket.
ops-bot: created ticket OPS-1298 for granting temporary decrypt access to decrypt_legacy_audit.py
sam.t: I'll include logic in the backfill to prefer decrypted legacy envelope actor if available, otherwise include the event with actor.placeholder="unknown_service_account" and a provenance flag.
raj.k: For validation, after backfill we should run a reconciliation query: count(auditstore.permission_change) vs count(export CSV) and diff < 1% threshold; create an alert if delta > 5%.
natalie.g: I'll add a daily reconciliation monitor in the console and an alert channel to #eng-sre if diffs spike. Also adding a unit/regression test to the export pipeline to ensure actor filter never reappears.
marta.s: Please file a JIRA for this compliance incident: SEC-4821. Include root cause, timeline, backfill plan, and owners. Owners: sam.t (hotfix + backfill), natalie.g (decrypt + alert), raj.k (reconciliation + validation), marta.s (compliance comms).
security-bot: ticket created: SEC-4821
marta.s: Thanks team. Once PR and backfill are running drop links here so I can update compliance and legal. We'll do a short postmortem focused on the export guard + KMS envelope handling.
sam.t: Will do — PR link and backfill manifest posted in thread when ready. :thumbsup:
natalie.g: Adding regression tests and alert dashboard now. :eyes:
raj.k: Suggest we also tag future RBAC refactors with an "audit-impact" checklist item in PR template.
marta.s: Agree. Adding checklist item to SECURITY PR template. Closing interim thread until hotfix/backfill updates.
